input.name: A0 audio embedding (mnv4_audio.onnx clean A0, the app track vector)
input.preprocess: x = track embedding L2-normalised; z = (x - input_mean) / input_std

family.other_means: no score.family() family (maps to family = null in the ranker)

descriptor.graph: d = normalize(normalize(p @ family_descriptor_means) + normalize(ridge.weight @ z + ridge.bias))
descriptor.space: artist_knowledge.bin v3 decoded descriptor (score.Pack.vector), unit norm

layout: little-endian; tensors at byte offsets; float32 row-major [out, in] for weights; int8 file: weights int8 [out, in] then float32 per-row scales at scale_offset (w = q * scale[row]); biases, means, stds and tables float32
training_data: FMA (Defferrard et al. 2017) official training split, tracks under CC BY / CC0 / public domain only; FMA metadata CC BY 4.0; descriptor targets from the shipped artist knowledge pack
imputed_flag: every block filled from this head must carry imputed = true in the ranker features
